pedal: Boss NS-2 Noise Suppressor (mono: Input -> Output; Send/Return empty)
comment: Matched quiet/loud history at three selected levels. Keep Threshold at the untouched locator 3:00 position; Mode Reduction. Engaged minimum Decay, engaged maximum Decay, then true bypass. Each long take has deliberately silent 24 s resets; let it run. No manual switching during a take.

takes.name: history-threshold-0300-decay-0700
takes.note: NS-2 ON, Mode Reduction. Leave Threshold exactly where it was for the locator. Set Decay fully counter-clockwise. The 24-second silent stretches are intentional resets; do not stop, switch or adjust anything during the take.

takes.name: history-threshold-0300-decay-0500
takes.note: NS-2 ON, Mode Reduction. Leave Threshold exactly where it was for the locator. Set Decay fully clockwise. The 24-second silent stretches are intentional resets; do not stop, switch or adjust anything during the take.

takes.name: bypass-history-check-1000
takes.note: Switch NS-2 OFF / BYPASSED now. Leave all knobs, cables and interface gain unchanged. This short true-bypass check verifies the locator calibration at the probe levels.
